content: Created the scoped governance corpus only: an English repository-local AGENTS guide, six focused personas, delivery/documentation/security rules, and the Issue-to-merge workflow. The documents encode the post-initial-commit isolated worktree lifecycle, the unborn shared-checkout exception, independent review plus CI, and mandatory bitty-docs synchronization. No product code or remote mutation was introduced.

Validation passed: carryctx doctor reports healthy; AGENTS.md is 97 lines; governance corpus contains exactly six requested personas, three requested rules, and issue-to-merge workflow; Markdown local links resolve and AGENTS/README contain zero local Markdown links; CJK and trailing whitespace are zero; git diff --check passes; scope conflicts are empty; repository remains unborn with zero commits.

Keep deployment manual/main-only, no docs consumer/adapter/Worker script, and no secret reads. Optional favicon and Dependabot scopes were removed.

Started the scoped website bootstrap after confirming bitty-docs CTX-0009 is completed, all local dependencies are satisfied, and task scopes have no conflicts. Implementation will remain static-only, exact-versioned, secret-free in CI, and deployment will be configured but never executed.

User override on 2026-08-25: use current latest tool versions, specifically TypeScript 7.0.2 and Bun 1.4.0. This supersedes the readiness recommendation to use TypeScript 6.0.3. Validate the real @astrojs/check/TypeScript 7 combination with bun ci, astro check, and build; report an actual failure as a blocker and do not silently downgrade.

User override requires the latest TypeScript 7.0.2 instead of the earlier peer-compatible 6.0.3 recommendation. @astrojs/check 0.9.10 currently declares a TypeScript peer range of ^5.0.0 or ^6.0.0, so the exact requested combination may emit a peer warning or fail. Do not downgrade silently; determine compatibility from the actual frozen install, astro check, and static build.

Upstream limitation confirmed and handled without downgrading the user-required TypeScript 7.0.2: Astro 7.2.6 astro check cannot run because its language server requires a programmatic TypeScript API not exposed by the native compiler. Removed the now-unused @astrojs/check dependency, regenerated the frozen lockfile, and replaced the repository type gate with native tsc --noEmit; astro build separately compiles the Astro template. This mitigation passes but is not equivalent to full Astro language-server diagnostics. README links the official Astro TypeScript 7 compatibility discussion and defers restoration to a separately reviewed task.

Implemented the complete CTX-0002 file scope with Bun 1.4.0 and exactly six requested devDependencies: Astro 7.2.6, @astrojs/check 0.9.10, TypeScript 7.0.2, Prettier 3.9.6, prettier-plugin-astro 0.14.1, and Wrangler 4.125.0. Bun generated bun.lock. The static Astro build creates one dist/index.html page; the dist gate confirms no _worker.js. Wrangler dry-run reads one asset, reports no bindings, and reaches its dry-run completion marker. Wrangler 4.125.0 leaves esbuild services alive after that marker locally, so the gate sends a bounded SIGINT after 15 seconds and requires both success markers; all output stays under ../tmp/bitty-website. Prettier, actionlint 1.7.12, git diff --check, trailing whitespace, CJK, README local-link, CI secret, deploy secret-name, forbidden integration, generated-output, and direct-dependency checks pass. just check intentionally remains red only at astro check because of PX-0007. No deployment, commit, push, adapter, docs consumer, route, domain, analytics, or secret read occurred. Three obsolete dry-run probe directories were moved recoverably to ../.trash/bitty-website/CTX-0002/tmp-probes-20260825.

Final non-downgrade verification passed: Bun 1.4.0 frozen install; TypeScript 7.0.2 native tsc; Astro 7.2.6 static build and dist/index contract; Wrangler 4.125.0 dry-run success markers with bounded cleanup; Prettier 3.9.6; actionlint 1.7.12; just check; git diff --check; five exact direct devDependencies; zero CJK, local README filesystem links, generated credential/path leakage, commits, pushes, or deploys.

Independent review completed with no findings. Evidence: Bun 1.4.0 frozen install reported no changes; npm registry latest versions and installed direct tree exactly match Astro 7.2.6, Prettier 3.9.6, prettier-plugin-astro 0.14.1, TypeScript 7.0.2, and Wrangler 4.125.0; package.json and bun.lock contain exactly those five direct dependencies and no @astrojs/check. README accurately states the TypeScript 7/Astro language-server limitation and explicitly says native tsc plus static build are not full Astro diagnostics. Manual source review confirms English semantic shell with lang, skip link, main/H1/footer, visible focus and no interactive custom control; static output/dist contract; no adapter, Worker main, bindings, docs consumer, routes, search, analytics, i18n, or copied canonical content. CI is read-only with full-SHA actions, exact Bun, bounded concurrency/timeout, frozen install, checksum-pinned actionlint, and no secrets. Deployment is workflow_dispatch plus main-only, production-environment guarded; only the final deploy step references the two approved Cloudflare secret names through environment variables, with no read/echo/log command and no CRATES_TOKEN. just check passed including native tsc, one-page Astro static build, dist/no-worker assertion, Wrangler 4.125.0 dry-run, and actionlint; separate actionlint and git diff --check passed. The dry-run pipeline uses bash -euo pipefail, truncating tee output, bounded timeout/kill, and requires both current-run success markers, so command failure, timeout failure, or missing markers remain nonzero; the observed run completed in 15.9 seconds within CI's 10-minute job timeout. CJK, README/AGENTS local-link, secret/forbidden-integration, generated-output leakage, and trailing-whitespace scans passed; .astro, dist, node_modules, .wrangler, and environment files are ignored. Reviewed file hashes were unchanged by validation.

CHANGELOG.md: Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 format per work order (reference used the 1.0.0 link; matrix explicitly names 1.1.0) plus Semantic Versioning adherence line; contains ONLY an '## [Unreleased]' section with '### Added' describing the governance scaffolding, framed as 'Proposed scaffolding only; no product behavior is implemented or implied'. commitlint.config.ts mirrored verbatim from reference (extends @commitlint/config-conventional); visually verified plausible TypeScript per work order (no installs run). .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc mirrors the reference config block verbatim (default true, MD013 off, MD024 siblings_only, MD033/MD041 off) with ignores set to node_modules/target/dist/build/site exactly as the file matrix specifies (reference had target/node_modules/.worktrees).

Verification evidence: (1) all six matrix files present on disk (ls -la confirms); (2) relative links in CONTRIBUTING.md resolve — only [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), which exists; SECURITY.md contains only the external HTTPS advisory URL, no relative links, no local/machine-specific paths (rg scan for ***REDACTED-PATH*** /home/, carryctx-cli across all new files: zero matches); (3) CHANGELOG headings follow Keep a Changelog (Changelog / [Unreleased] / Added) with no other version sections; (4) commitlint.config.ts visual TS check passes, identical shape to reference; (5) no existing file modified and no git write operation performed. Note: new files are outside package.json format globs, so 'just check' surface is unchanged.

FINAL SET — added (6/6): LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CHANGELOG.md, commitlint.config.ts, .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc. Skipped-because-exists: none.
